meta.title: "No one will be your friend" — why your child fears being left alone | Sila Slova
meta.description: Teach your child to resist the fear of isolation and hold their ground, even when threatened with loneliness. Game-based course for children aged 10–16.

hero.headline: "No one will be your friend!" — and your child is already afraid of being left alone?
hero.subheadline: Fear of rejection is one of the most powerful forces. When it's used as a threat — children give in. Even when they don't want to.

media.alt: A child being threatened with loneliness to make them agree

pain.title: "Everyone will turn away" — that's not a forecast, it's pressure
pain.body:
"No one will be your friend", "everyone will turn away", "you'll be left alone". In class, in a group, in a chat. The child might have doubts — but the fear of isolation is stronger. And they give in. Even when they didn't want to.

This isn't being dependent on others or weakness. It's a natural response to a basic fear — being rejected. When someone throws out the worst-case scenario of losing connection, the brain takes it seriously. No one checks if it's true — they just quickly agree to avoid the threat.

The result — the child abandons their own decisions to maintain acceptance. "Not my idea", "I'll agree because otherwise I'll be alone" — and this repeats every time they're pressured with the fear of loneliness.

faq.q: Is it a game or a learning course?
faq.a: Both at the same time. "Sila Slova" looks like a detective series, but every episode contains a hidden critical thinking lesson.

faq.q: What age is it suitable for?
faq.a: Ideal for 10–16 year olds. At this age, children are receptive to new thinking patterns and are still forming their views.

faq.q: How much time is needed each day?
faq.a: 15–20 minutes per episode. Flexible schedule — your child can come back at any convenient time.

faq.q: Is registration required for the demo?
faq.a: No. The demo episode is fully open — no registration, no subscription, no personal data required.
